## Example: parentElement

Earlier, you learned how to delete the last item from the list using remove().

Let's now suppose you want to add individual delete buttons for each item on the list.

![parentElement: Example](data:image/png;base64,)

When the delete button is clicked, the parent li item is deleted.

![parentElement: Example](data:image/png;base64,)
